shop1.text: Okay babe, this is it. His tent is right past this little monster. Go get your man!

shop2.text: Floor thirteen already? Don't pretend you're climbing for the relics. We both know who you're climbing for.

shop3.text: Act two, and he moved his tent up here too? Girl... that is not a coincidence.

shop4.text: Okay, listen. This is his last shop before the top. If you don't make him yours now... you never will.

bonus.text: Wait. He set up another tent?! He couldn't let you go! One more chance, babe. Don't blow it.

good.text: Oh my god. They're leaving the Spire together. Hand in hand. I'm not crying. You're crying.

friends.text: He called you a good customer. Customer. Oh babe... I'm so sorry. Ice cream?

fight.text: You lowballed him three times?! Babe, that's not flirting. That's a declaration of war.

up3.text: Ooh, he called you a regular! That's basically a pet name for him.

up4.text: He blushed. Babe, I saw it! Under the hood. He blushed!

up5.text: Darling?! He is so in love with you!

down.text: Oof. Babe. Why would you say that to him?

lowball2.text: Okay, that's two lowballs in a row. One more and he's gonna snap. I'm serious.

secret.text: Wait. He's hiding a secret card just for you? That is so romantic.

capped.text: Slow down, Romeo. He needs time. Try again next floor.
